name: esbuild-missing-binary
description: Resolving missing platform-specific binaries for esbuild.
problem: esbuild fails with 'The package @esbuild/win32-x64 could not be found'
cause: npm install was run with --no-optional or --omit=optional flags preventing platform-specific binaries from being downloaded

steps: Stop all Node.js processes: `Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force`
Run npm install WITHOUT --no-optional flag: `npm install`
Optionally use --force if permission issues arise: `npm install --force`

prevention: Always allow optional dependencies to be installed. Do not use --no-optional or --omit=optional flags.
